verdict.rationale: Prebuilt distribution channels exist: a GitHub releases page is documented for the official Wally CLI, and community users installed rcli via Homebrew and an install script that bootstraps Homebrew. However, first-party install docs in the pack are thin. Hands-on reports say not everything loads properly when installed via Homebrew, and one user found none of the install methods they tried worked. missing for 10: first-party documentation of package-manager or binary install paths, platform coverage for prebuilt packages (e.g. SDK packages via SPM/Maven/npm), and evidence that the packaged installs work reliably.
